name: Identities
about: Who an AI on this portal is over time, not what answers one request: the account it acts as (one stream per account, never switched), the model it is built on, how it answers (a mode: pipeline, values, roles), how much of its stream a turn is given, the LoRAs and memory that grow with it. Tessa > Collab answers as the identity its stream panel names; changing the identity changes Tessa everywhere it is used.

about.label: Who this is (shown where it answers)

account.label: Its account (the AI user it acts as)
account.hint: The portal account this identity is: its one stream, what it may see and do (Settings > Users and scopes), and who may talk with it (the grant use on ai:<account>). Empty: the portal's AI account (AI_USER in .env, else aviary).

mode.label: How it answers
mode.hint: A mode keeps the pipeline, its values (prompt, context window, contexts) and the model in each role. Make one from a Chat conversation (Save as a mode) and pick it here. Empty: the face's own pipeline and values.

recall_last.label: Messages of its stream given each turn
recall_last.hint: Only that many of the latest messages; 0: all, fitted to the context window by the pipeline. The stream itself keeps everything.

recall_within_partner.label: With others, recall only what was said with them
recall_within_partner.hint: On: talking with someone who is not a primary user, it is given only that person's part of its stream. Off: it is given all of it and decides itself what to share, as any user would.

show_last.label: Messages of its stream shown on the page
show_last.hint: Only the drawing: the stream keeps everything, and what a turn is given is set above.

memory.label: Its long-term memory (knowledge group)
memory.hint: The knowledge group that holds what it keeps between conversations. Stored here; read by pipelines that take a memory group.

loras.label: LoRAs built for it
loras.hint: Adapter files trained for this identity, by name. Stored here; applying them per request is not built yet.
